tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gter gsar bla ma drag po'i brgyud 'debs ni/1$0000300 khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur// brtse chen thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs// rgyal kun ngo bo pad+ma 'byung gnas la// gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// bde chen ye shes skyed mdzad mkhar chen bza'// 'jig rten mig gcig lo chen bai ro'i zhabs// zab gter sgo 'byed 'gyur med rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// rab 'byams zhi dang khro bo'i dkyil 'khor gyi// spyi gzugs khrag 'thung dbang drag thod phreng rtsal// ma dang mkha' 'gro dam can gter srung la// gsol ba 'debs so dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol// srid las nges 'byung thar pa don du gnyer// brgyud ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs snying la zhugs// smin byed dbang gis rgyud smin grol byed kyi// rim gnyis rnal 'byor lam du longs par shog /dam chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen mi mthun gegs// nyer zhi mthun rkyen ma tshang med 'byor pas// don gnyis lhun grub dbang drag dkyil 'khor lha'i// go 'phang mngon du 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs//
zhes lam 'di la rnal 'byor du mdzad pa dge slong shes rab bzang pos bskul ba las/ snyom las pa 'gyur med rdo rjes bris pa'o/// /
